title: Hypothesis hunter reply (persona-facing)
description: What a code-reading hunter writes: its judgment only. The orchestrator derives ids, hashes, hunter identity, shard, ordering and citation objects; do not write them. Bounds enforced in code: at most brief.limits.max_hypotheses items, end_line - start_line <= brief.limits.max_line_span, mechanism <= 2000 chars. Known-list mode only: every hypothesis names its catalog_section, and every catalog section is either named by a hypothesis or listed once in catalog_coverage.

hypotheses.description: Zero or more vulnerability hypotheses. An empty list is a valid answer.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the target file, exactly as listed under the target-repository root (no root prefix, no absolute path).

start_line.description: First line (1-based) of the vulnerable construct.

end_line.description: Last line (>= start_line). Omit for a single line.

vulnerability_class.description: Short weakness name, e.g. 'stack buffer overflow via unbounded copy'.

cwe.description: CWE id such as CWE-121 when you can name one; null otherwise.

mechanism.description: How attacker-influenced data reaches the construct and what breaks. Candidate wording only.

attacker_preconditions.description: What the attacker must control or be positioned to do.

evidence.description: What you read: 'path:line' or 'path:start-end' in the target, or a readable input ref 'root:path' (e.g. a supporting-evidence menu file). The hypothesis location itself is added for you.

component_id.description: Optional component id from the brief.

catalog_section.description: Known-list mode: the known-issue-catalog.md section this hypothesis comes from. General mode: omit.

catalog_coverage.description: Known-list mode: one entry for each catalog section no hypothesis names. General mode: omit.

status.description: not_applicable: you looked and the target has no matching code or configuration. not_checked: you could not look (say why).

statement.description: not_applicable: what you searched or read and found absent. not_checked: why you could not check.

evidence.description: Refs to what you read, as for a hypothesis. At least one for not_applicable.
